integrity: The projective smoothness, complete-intersection degree/genus, secant count, tangent-bundle equations, and a reduced 12-point affine linear section are independently reconstructed. The packaged section computation uses exact rational Gröbner-basis arithmetic and a squarefreeness check.
scientific_limitations: This is one explicit equality case for the 2026 secant-corrected tangent-bundle degree bound, not a classification. The exact lower bound comes from a single complementary affine linear section, while the upper bound uses the published theorem and classical general-projection theory.
title: A sharp degree-12 tangent bundle for an affine elliptic quartic
